limitations: These five runs measure context selection and conservative byte-based token estimates only; no coding agent, answer generation, paid provider, duration, task correctness, human review, or rule-violation metric was involved.
No adjudicated relevance qrels exist in this report. Included source paths and deterministic lexical relevance scores are inspectable retrieval proxies, not ground-truth recall.
A separate MLI-01 probe at budget 32768 overflowed and did not select the approved knowledge item; the five comparable report cases use the fixed 131072-token budget and had no overflow.
Task-level pilot outcomes under freeze v2 remain zero valid runs; this report does not count toward the 45 agent runs.
